rawValueRestrictions.color: no raw hex/rgb/hsl colour anywhere in a PageSpec; reference a color.* token
rawValueRestrictions.gradient: gradients only through gradient.* tokens on the sections that own them
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: no raw px/rem/vw lengths; spacing is owned by section contracts
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: only font.family.* tokens (display = heading face, text = body face); no other font
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: type sizes are owned by section contracts and switch per breakpoint (see responsive values)

unsupportedFontsNote: Georgia/Arial/monospace exist only as fallbacks or one counter digit style; a generated page may not choose them directly.

surface.note: The only per-instance token override a PageSpec node can carry: the section's background surface, restricted to the surfaces that section really renders.

overrides: PageSpec nodes carry no other style/token overrides; typography, spacing, radius and elevation are owned by the section contracts.
